SELECT
  p.productSKU,
  p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  SUM(IFNULL(p.productQuantity, 0)) AS total_quantity_sold,
  SUM(IFNULL(p.productRevenue, 0)) AS total_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  -- sessions that include the target product
  AND fullVisitorId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h2,
    UNNEST(h2.product) AS p2
    WHERE
      _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
      AND p2.v2ProductName = 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley'
  )
  -- exclude the product itself
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley'
GROUP BY
  p.productSKU,
  p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY
  total_quantity_sold DESC,
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
